title: Colosseum 1.1.4
summary: Vault becomes a full local-library surface, acquisition intent is consistent across worlds, catalogues fetch themselves, and the account backend lands while sign-in remains unavailable until deployment.

highlights.title: Your local library grows up
highlights.body: Search and type-to-find, sort and filters, honest empty/error states, keyboard navigation, watched controls, progress and Continue now live on Vault's browse surface.

highlights.title: Shows know their seasons
highlights.body: Shows and seasons get a real presentation with parsed years, media-bearing Bonus/OVA folders, durations, local artwork, IMDb ratings and genres.

highlights.title: Storage stays under your control
highlights.body: Rescan, forget a root, edit ignore patterns, remove Downloads entries, and see folder-aware counts without leaving the Vault surface.

highlights.title: Read now, download later
highlights.body: Read opens content as soon as it can open. Download acquires it and stops at Ready across comics, Tankoban volumes, and both Biblio transports.

highlights.title: They fetch themselves
highlights.body: The installer stays lean while anime/manga, Tankoban volumes, comics and IMDb catalogues fetch into AppData on first launch; the comics catalogue now drives Discover and series ledgers.

highlights.title: Volume identity
highlights.body: A shared string-safe volume grammar keeps source selection and file selection aligned, reducing mismatches and misfiled acquisitions.

highlights.title: Theatre, runtime, distribution
highlights.body: Theatre uses one episode scroll surface, session authority and update services are hardened natively, and quiet uninstall plus WinGet/Chocolatey packaging improve distribution.

highlights.title: Backend landed, sign-in did not
highlights.body: The Go account service, CI path and deployment seam are in-tree, but no production endpoint is deployed, so account creation, sign-in and cloud sync remain unavailable.
